reason: Scalping edge is pre-market only on 1-5min or tick action with news/volume/order-book checks and does not survive daily-bar approximation.

universe.description: US stocks with pre-market volume and news

setup.rule: Scan stocks moving on news/volume/short float
setup.quote: click on every stock and basically check why the stock is up see if there is some sort of news about that stock see if there was a volume premarket check if there is any short float

entry.rule: Trade with trend on news or mean-revert to close
entry.quote: I have setups that I I take the news and I trade with the trend and I have setups that I just take the news and I mean revert to the to the mean

stop.quote: when I'm wrong, I just cut my loss. I mean, I I don't think about the trade anymore

exits.rule: Mean-revert to flat/close or small target on trend
exits.quote: if I short something at 5% up, I'm looking to cover it at flat

sizing.rule: Take what liquidity allows, small winners add up
sizing.quote: trades add up, even if it's a really small trade

market_filter.quote: I'm a successful pre-market trader mostly because most of the Americans are sleeping at that time

ambiguities.issue: Mentions occasional shorting and after-hours holds
ambiguities.assumption: Main method remains pre-market scalping; short-only not applicable
